plugins.name: command-room
plugins.description: Claude as your chief of staff. Turns a folder of notes, transcripts, and emails into an executive workspace. Daily loop: morning briefing, inbox triage, meeting prep, follow-up ritual. Writing: emails, Slack, memos, one-pagers, board updates — voice-calibrated to you. Memory layer: decision log, insights, weekly audit. Per-workspace skills generate from your own context.
